name: Red Sea International Film Festival
description: Red Sea International Film Festival brand profile for the 2026 theme 'Cinema Lives Here'. Editorial, cinematic, bilingual (English + Arabic), frame-driven.

theme.title: Cinema Lives Here
theme.manifestoVoice: Contemplative, declarative, poetic. Short sentences. Anaphora. Repetition as emphasis.

colors.signatureLabel: Chartreuse / Frame accent. Cover + signature frame color — sits outside the photographic palette.
colors._notes: Hex values are visual approximations extracted from the brand deck palette sheet. Team should replace with canonical values from the master brand spec if available.

english.use: All English text — display and body. Heavy weights for titles, regular for body.

arabicTitle.fallback: 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic', 'Noto Kufi Arabic', 'Tajawal', sans-serif

fonts._notes: Nohemi, Panorama and Rawasi are licensed. Drop font files into brands/red-sea/assets/fonts/ to render canonical type; otherwise the fallback stacks are used.

h2.note: Thin-weight all-caps, editorial page title style (e.g. 'INTRODUCTION')

rule.note: Hairline-to-thin horizontal rules above and below titles

borderRadius._note: Brand is strictly rectilinear — no rounded corners anywhere.

designDevice.name: The Frame
designDevice.description: A living rectangular outline inspired by the director's viewfinder. Always adjusting, never static.

should: Feel intentional in what it includes and excludes
Interact with subject, not sit around it
Allow moments to extend beyond it when needed

shape.style: Stepped / asymmetric / jigsaw outline — rarely a simple rectangle
shape.strokeWidthNote: Stroke is ~1.5% of the frame's longest side — substantial but not chunky

designDevice.motionRules: The Frame should animate in every scene. Reframe, crop in/out, shift, scale, or morph its stepped silhouette. Subjects should periodically break containment.

bilingual.rule: English and Arabic are woven together at matching scale. Neither subordinate. Arabic is not a translation afterthought — it sits alongside or interleaved with English.
bilingual.example: CINEMA / السينما / LIVES / تعيش / HERE / هنا

photography.style: Contemporary cinematic portraiture of people with cameras and subjects, often in Saudi settings (Jeddah sculpture park, historic architecture, sea). Natural light. Saturated, not desaturated.
photography.treatment: Cutout collage — subjects are isolated from backgrounds and pasted onto color blocks from the palette. Multiple photos can overlap within a single composition.
photography.director: B&W archival / editorial references of directors (framing gesture) allowed as secondary imagery.

pageChrome.description: Editorial page layout used on deck and printed/digital materials

_needed: Drop the RSIFF logo files (SVG preferred, PNG acceptable) into assets/logos/ — black and white variants of both the horizontal and vertical lockups.
Drop Nohemi, Panorama, and Rawasi font files into assets/fonts/ if licensed — otherwise the fallback font stacks are used.
